derivation: perhaps from the base of G4628 (σκέλος) and G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);
def: withered at the front, i.e. a point or prickle (figuratively, a bodily annoyance or disability)

occurrences.text: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
